newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Spain's Endesa drawn to EDP sale-minister.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Endesa drawn to EDP sale-minister.

text.p: Spanish electricity company Endesa is interested in the coming privatisation of Portugual's state EDP-Electricidade de Portugal, although no decisions have been taken, Spanish Industry and Energy Minister Jose Pique said in Monday.
"It is logical for Endesa to be interested," Pique told a news conference.
Pique was in Lisbon for talks with his Portuguese counterpart Augusto Mateus.

The Portuguese government is planning to privatise up to 49 percent of EDP in an operation set for this spring. Spain has privatised 30 percent of Endesa and plans to sell a further tranche later this year.
